newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Poll. Control Fin. A-plus/F-1 - Fitch.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Poll. Control Fin. A-plus/F-1 - Fitch.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct 17 - California Pollution Control Financing Authority's $24 million variable rate demand solid waste disposal revenue bonds (EDCO Disposal Corp. Project), series 1996A, are rated 'A+'/'F-1' by Fitch Investors Service.

Interest rate on the bonds is initially set at a weekly rate. The first interest payment date is Nov. 6, 1996. During any weekly interest rate period, owners of the bonds will have the option to demand purchase of their bonds with no less than seven days notice. Bonds are subject to optional and mandatory redemption.

The rating is based on the 100% support provided by a transferable, irrevocable direct pay letter of credit by Wells Fargo Bank, National Association and will expire on the earlier of Oct. 17, 2001 (unless extended pursuant to the terms of the letter of credit) or other termination of the letter of credit.
